# SETX Football Camp

> A two-day youth football camp for kids ages 5 to 12 in Daisetta, Southeast
> Texas, run by Clayton Hanks and Timothy Taylor Sr. Registration is open for
> July 2027. There are no tryouts, every camper gets a shirt, and the only cost
> is $5 per shirt.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.setxfootball.org/): What the camp is, who runs it, what a camper gets, and the three steps to sign up.
- [About](https://www.setxfootball.org/about): The camp's story, the two co-founder head coaches, and how the field stays open to every family.
- [Register](https://www.setxfootball.org/register): The roster form. One entry per camper, with a shirt size, then $5 per shirt by CashApp to $SETXYFC.
- [Gallery](https://www.setxfootball.org/gallery): Photographs from past seasons on the field in Daisetta.
- [Sponsors](https://www.setxfootball.org/sponsors): The local businesses whose sponsorship covers shirts, drinks, and snacks.
- [Contact](https://www.setxfootball.org/contact): Phone, email, and where the field is, for sign-up questions and what a camper brings.
- [Design](https://www.setxfootball.org/design): The visual identity behind the site, its palette, and its type.

## Details

- Ages: 5 to 12. No tryouts and no bench; every kid who shows up plays.
- Dates: two half-days, July 2027.
- Place: Daisetta, Liberty County, Texas.
- Cost: $5 per shirt. Nothing is due at sign-up. Drinks and snacks are free.
- Coaches: every coach has cleared a background check. Guest pro athletes coach and speak.
- Contact: +1-936-641-0681
